status: G5 final batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-signal, in Chapters I, II, III, IV, VII, VIII, X and XII (on the web in Chapters II and III only)
use: The battle's signal station (the field object 'signal') on its cell in every state, in the battles of the Roman west; the objective's marker shows whether it is secured.

generator.prompt: A Roman frontier signal post: a thick squared oak mast about three metres tall rising from a low cairn of grey fieldstones and braced by three short raking struts, a crossbar near the top hung with a long red woollen signal banner, an iron fire basket on the top of the mast, and leaning against the cairn a tall conical stack of straw bundles and split logs ready for a beacon fire; about one and a half metres across at its foot. Weathered oak, grey fieldstone, black iron, golden straw and red wool. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
